evidence: Walking and Running clips embedded in the GLB
Walking clip advanced through an independent Three.js AnimationMixer for every spawned enemy
In-place hip translation returned to its starting position at the loop seam
rig_and_motion.notes: The game uses the authored Walking clip. Attack, hit, and death remain root-level code feedback for this tutorial iteration.

evidence: GLTFLoader loaded the animated GLB over HTTP
Every animated enemy received its own AnimationMixer
No required-request, page, console-error, or WebGL failure was observed
engine_import.notes: EnemyVisual updates cloned world matrices before normalizing height, preserves Meshy's 0.01 armature scale, grounds the mesh, and keeps gameplay travel outside the walk clip.

evidence: Rigged enemies remained 1.8 world units tall and visible in the real arena camera
The Walking clip advanced during active play
The V3 combat, failure, and restart paths remain owned outside the asset adapter
game_camera.notes: The lighter V3 arena and low purple emissive fill preserve the charcoal monster's gameplay readability.

runtime_performance.notes: No formal frame-time or memory budget has been measured.

target_runtime.notes: The declared desktop-web target passed. Mobile and lower-end hardware remain outside the V3 target.
